title: The guest who came yesterday
goal: Describe people by what they have done, with -An before the noun.

intro.text: For what has happened, use `-An` (*-n* after a vowel): *düýn gelen myhman* (the guest who came yesterday), *bu suraty çeken gyz* (the girl who drew this picture). It also names a state: *gyzyl köýnek geýen gyz*, the girl (who has put on, so is wearing) a red dress.

vocab.en: young man (ýigidi: the young man, as an object)

exercises.question: Which phrase means **the guest who came yesterday**?

why.1: `-ýAn` is for what is going on. For what has happened: *gelen*.
why.2: This is a sentence: **the guest came yesterday**.
why.3: Before a noun, use the participle: *gelen myhman*.

exercises.explain: After a vowel `-An` is just *-n*, and the final e becomes ä: *işlän*.
Before a vowel the t of *aýt-* becomes d: *aýdan*.

exercises.en: Who's the girl in the red dress?

reject.why: *Geýýän* is **who (usually) wears**. For the dress she has on now: *geýen*.

exercises.explain: Clothes you have on are clothes you **have put on**: *geýen*.

accept: The guest who came yesterday is from Dashoguz.
The guest who arrived yesterday is from Dashoguz.

exercises.prompt: The guests who came to the wedding danced.

reject.why: The description comes before the noun: *toýa gelen myhmanlar*.

exercises.explain: *toýa gelen myhmanlar* (the guests who came to the wedding) + *tans etdiler*.

exercises.prompt: Who is the young man who met us at the station?
Bu suraty çeken gyz meniň jigim.
accept: The girl who drew this picture is my little sister.
The girl who painted this picture is my little sister.
The girl who [drew|painted] this picture is my younger sister.

exercises.question: What does *kitap okan oglan* mean?
options: the boy who read a book
the boy who is reading a book
the boy who will read a book

why.1: That one is *kitap okaýan oglan*, with `-ýAn`.
why.2: That needs another participle, in [B1 unit 6](b1-u06).

exercises.explain: `-An` is for what has happened: *okan*, who read. The noun after it is the doer: the boy.

exercises.prompt: I know the man who wrote this book.
accept: Men bu kitaby ýazan adamy tanaýaryn.

reject.answer: Men bu kitaby ýazýan adamy tanaýaryn.
Men adamy bu kitaby ýazan tanaýaryn.
reject.why: The description comes before the noun: *bu kitaby ýazan adamy*.

exercises.explain: *bu kitaby ýazan adam* (the man who wrote this book), in the accusative after *tanamak*: *adamy*.

exercises.en: The guests who came from Mary have already left.

exercises.prompt: Gyzyl köýnek geýen gyz meniň kärdeşim.
accept: The girl in the red dress is my colleague.
The girl wearing the red dress is my colleague.
The girl who is wearing a red dress is my colleague.
The girl in a red dress is my colleague.
The girl wearing a red dress is my colleague.
The girl in the red [dress|shirt] is my co-worker.
